Cấu hình gp3 provisioned IOPS/throughput độc lập size (tới 16000 IOPS, 1000 MiB/s) và io2 provisioned IOPS high-durability cho database latency-sensitive
Hiểu ràng buộc AZ-scoped của EBS: volume attach chỉ vào instance cùng AZ, cross-AZ transfer yêu cầu snapshot + restore
Bake incremental snapshot point-in-time và restore từ S3 internal, biết lazy-load cold read khi restore lần đầu

en: Choose the right EBS volume type (gp3/io2/st1) based on workload metric: IOPS-bound OLTP uses io2, throughput-cold sequential uses st1, default gp3 with baseline 3000 IOPS
Configure gp3 provisioned IOPS/throughput independent of size (up to 16000 IOPS, 1000 MiB/s) and io2 provisioned IOPS for database latency-sensitive workloads
Understand EBS AZ-scoped constraint: volume attaches only to instance in same AZ, cross-AZ transfer requires snapshot and restore
Create incremental point-in-time snapshots and restore from S3 internal storage, aware of lazy-load cold read on first restore
Debug unexpected EBS bill: detached volumes still charge, orphan snapshots from deleted volumes, over-provisioned IOPS
